attBesluta.text: I ordered this shelf unit to go on the back of a closet door in a nursing home....the staff approves and this is a wonderful way to add extra storage space....I store my friend's snacks and even his size 13 shoes!....also I think I will try adding depends....the closet doors are narrow and this shelf fits....best idea ever for a facility....it has to be assembled tho but a maintenance man there did that
